question: When was Swami Vivekananda born?
solution:
The correct answer is __**12 January 1863**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Swami Vivekananda** was born on **12 January 1863**.
 
• He was a key figure in the introduction of Indian philosophies of Vedanta and Yoga to the Western world.
 
• He is credited with raising interfaith awareness, bringing Hinduism to the status of a major world religion in the late 19th century.
 
• He was a major force in the revival of Hinduism in India and contributed to the concept of nationalism in colonial India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Swami Vivekananda was born as **Narendranath Datta** in a Bengali family in Calcutta (now Kolkata).
 
• He was a chief disciple of the 19th-century Indian mystic Ramakrishna.
 
• He founded the Ramakrishna Math and the Ramakrishna Mission.
 
• He is best known for his speech which began with the words "**Sisters and brothers of America**," at the Parliament of the World's Religions in Chicago in 1893.
 
• His birthday, 12 January, is celebrated as **National Youth Day** in India.
